key: GARDEVOIR: We are here live at the Vanhanen Castle Gym with the challenger, \PN, endeavoring to earn their eighth official Reborn League Badge!
en: GARDEVOIR: We are here live at the Vanhanen Castle Gym with the challenger, \PN, endeavoring to earn their eighth official Reborn League Badge!
ja: サーナイト: ヴァンハネン城ジムより生放送でお届けしております、挑戦者\PNが、リボーンリーグ公式8個目のバッジ獲得に挑みますわ!

key: Will she fly, or will she fall?!
en: Will she fly, or will she fall?!
ja: 彼女は飛び立つのか、それとも堕ちるのか?!

key: Will they fly, or will they fall?!
en: Will they fly, or will they fall?!
ja: 彼らは飛び立つのか、それとも堕ちるのか?!

key: Will he fly, or will he fall!?
en: Will he fly, or will he fall!?
ja: 彼は飛び立つのか、それとも堕ちるのか!?

key: We'll find out soon-- BUT~!
en: We'll find out soon-- BUT~!
ja: すぐにわかりますが――でも~!

key: The Gym Battle alone is not the only trial that yet awaits our eager hero!
en: The Gym Battle alone is not the only trial that yet awaits our eager hero!
ja: このジムバトルだけが、我らが熱心な英雄を待ち受ける試練ではありませんの!

key: Master~ Would you do the honors?
en: Master~ Would you do the honors?
ja: ご主人様~ どうぞ、お話しになってくださいな?

key: RADOMUS: Naturally. Allow me to explain--
en: RADOMUS: Naturally. Allow me to explain--
ja: ラドマス: もちろん。説明させてもらおう――

key: GARDEVOIR: As you may have heard, Master is a world-renowned master of chess~
en: GARDEVOIR: As you may have heard, Master is a world-renowned master of chess~
ja: サーナイト: すでにお聞き及びかもしれませんが、ご主人様は世界的に名高いチェスの達人ですのよ~

key: RADOMUS: Was I not going to do the honor?
en: RADOMUS: Was I not going to do the honor?
ja: ラドマス: 私が説明する番ではなかったかね?

key: GARDEVOIR: Ahaha~ Sorry, Master, the floor is yours!
en: GARDEVOIR: Ahaha~ Sorry, Master, the floor is yours!
ja: サーナイト: あはは~ ごめんなさい、ご主人様、どうぞお続けを!

key: RADOMUS: And speaking of the floor, you will notice that it is arranged like a chess board.
en: RADOMUS: And speaking of the floor, you will notice that it is arranged like a chess board.
ja: ラドマス: 床と言えば、これがチェス盤のように配置されていることに気づくだろう。

key: Now, of course, it would be all too unfair for me to ask you to face off against me in such a game.
en: Now, of course, it would be all too unfair for me to ask you to face off against me in such a game.
ja: もちろん、このようなゲームで私と直接対局してもらうのは、あまりにも不公平というものだ。

key: Fear not; I will not be so unscrupulous.
en: Fear not; I will not be so unscrupulous.
ja: 心配は無用、そこまで卑劣なことはしないとも。

key: Here, instead, is your task:
en: Here, instead, is your task:
ja: その代わりに、君の課題はこうだ:

key: Obeying the normal rules of each chess piece, arrange your pieces in such a way that I am placed in checkmate.
en: Obeying the normal rules of each chess piece, arrange your pieces in such a way that I am placed in checkmate.
ja: チェスの各駒の通常のルールに従い、私をチェックメイトにするように駒を配置しなさい。

key: There are also new restrictions on each of us:
en: There are also new restrictions on each of us:
ja: また、私たち双方に、新たな制約がある:

key: I may not move my pieces.
en: I may not move my pieces.
ja: 私は自分の駒を動かせない。

key: However, you may not capture them.
en: However, you may not capture them.
ja: だが、君は私の駒を取ることもできない。

key: All pieces still are considered to attack their normal territory.
en: All pieces still are considered to attack their normal territory.
ja: すべての駒は、依然として通常の攻撃範囲を持つものとみなされる。

key: In other words, you have an infinite number of turns to find a solution of checkmate, with my pieces locked into their present positions.
en: In other words, you have an infinite number of turns to find a solution of checkmate, with my pieces locked into their present positions.
ja: つまり、私の駒が現在の位置に固定されたまま、チェックメイトの解を見つけるための手数は無制限だ。

key: When you think you have found a solution, please access the door below me to check.
en: When you think you have found a solution, please access the door below me to check.
ja: 解を見つけたと思ったら、私の下にあるドアにアクセスして確認しなさい。

key: Finally, if you have any questions regarding the normal rules of pieces or play, my butler will address them in the room on the left.
en: Finally, if you have any questions regarding the normal rules of pieces or play, my butler will address them in the room on the left.
ja: 最後に、駒やプレイの通常ルールについて質問があれば、左の部屋にいる私の執事が答えてくれるだろう。

key: Best of luck to you.
en: Best of luck to you.
ja: 幸運を祈る。

key: Observe how the sole warrior on the board, her Lady, may pose a fine fight yet!
en: Observe how the sole warrior on the board, her Lady, may pose a fine fight yet!
ja: ご覧あれ、盤上でただ一人の戦士たる貴婦人が、まだ見事な戦いを見せるかもしれませんことよ!

key: The Queen is the strongest piece-- never forget!
en: The Queen is the strongest piece-- never forget!
ja: パセリ: クイーンは最強の駒だ――忘れるな!

key: Onwards, young Queen.
en: Onwards, young Queen.
ja: 進め、若きクイーンよ。

key: Onwards, young Majesty.
en: Onwards, young Majesty.
ja: 進め、若き陛下よ。

key: Onwards, young King.
en: Onwards, young King.
ja: 進め、若き王よ。

key: RADOMUS: Are you quite through? Shall we check the board?
en: RADOMUS: Are you quite through? Shall we check the board?
ja: ラドマス: もう終わったかね? 盤面を確認しようか?

key: RADOMUS: Very well.
en: RADOMUS: Very well.
ja: ラドマス: よろしい。

key: Oh-ho. You are very close! Perhaps too close.
en: Oh-ho. You are very close! Perhaps too close.
ja: ほほう。かなり近いな! いや、近すぎるかもしれない。

key: In fact, with as close as your Rook is, the Black King can merely capture it to escape from check.
en: In fact, with as close as your Rook is, the Black King can merely capture it to escape from check.
ja: 実際、君のルークがこれほど近いと、黒の王はそれを取るだけでチェックから逃れられてしまう。

key: RADOMUS: Indeed, that would be checkmate. Very good!
en: RADOMUS: Indeed, that would be checkmate. Very good!
ja: ラドマス: 確かに、これならチェックメイトだ。実に見事!

key: However!
en: However!
ja: しかし!

key: There is one more trial for this room.
en: There is one more trial for this room.
ja: この部屋には、もうひとつ試練がある。

key: In a normal chess game, one need only corner the King for the game to be over.
en: In a normal chess game, one need only corner the King for the game to be over.
ja: 通常のチェスでは、王を追い詰めさえすればゲームは終わる。

key: Alas, this is not a normal chess game.
en: Alas, this is not a normal chess game.
ja: だが残念、これは通常のチェスではない。

key: Our King will fight back!
en: Our King will fight back!
ja: 我らが王は、反撃してくるのだ!

key: RADOMUS: I'll leave you to that one.
en: RADOMUS: I'll leave you to that one.
ja: ラドマス: それは君に任せよう。

key: I'll be waiting at the end. See you soon, \PN.
en: I'll be waiting at the end. See you soon, \PN.
ja: 最後で待っているとしよう。またすぐに会おう、\PN。

key: RADOMUS: Ah, it looks like you've made an illegal move.
en: RADOMUS: Ah, it looks like you've made an illegal move.
ja: ラドマス: おや、不正な手を打ったようだね。

key: By bringing your King so close to mine, you've placed yourself into check.
en: By bringing your King so close to mine, you've placed yourself into check.
ja: 君の王を、私の王にそれほど近づけたことで、自らチェックの状態に陥ってしまった。

key: Careful now.
en: Careful now.
ja: 気をつけて。

key: RADOMUS: Hm... Seems you're not quite there yet.
en: RADOMUS: Hm... Seems you're not quite there yet.
ja: ラドマス: ふむ……まだ、そこまでは至っていないようだね。

key: You're going to need to have both of your pieces doing work for this one.
en: You're going to need to have both of your pieces doing work for this one.
ja: これには、君の両方の駒に働いてもらう必要があるだろう。

key: However! There is one more trial for this room.
en: However! There is one more trial for this room.
ja: しかし! この部屋には、もうひとつ試練がある。

key: RADOMUS: Ah, it looks like you've made an illegal move. By bringing your King so close to mine, you've placed yourself into check.
en: RADOMUS: Ah, it looks like you've made an illegal move. By bringing your King so close to mine, you've placed yourself into check.
ja: ラドマス: おや、不正な手を打ったようだね。君の王を、私の王にそれほど近づけたことで、自らチェックの状態に陥ってしまった。

key: RADOMUS: Hm... Seems you're not quite there yet. You're going to need to have both of your pieces doing work for this one.
en: RADOMUS: Hm... Seems you're not quite there yet.  You're going to need to have both of your pieces doing work for this one.
ja: ラドマス: ふむ……まだ、そこまでは至っていないようだね。これには、君の両方の駒に働いてもらう必要があるだろう。

key: RADOMUS: Hm... It seems you're not quite there yet. Keep in mind how each piece 'attacks' the spaces nearby it.
en: RADOMUS: Hm... It seems you're not quite there yet.  Keep in mind how each piece 'attacks' the spaces nearby it.
ja: ラドマス: ふむ……まだ、そこまでは至っていないようだね。それぞれの駒が、周囲のどの空間を「攻撃」するか、よく考えるといい。

key: RADOMUS: You have as much time as you need.
en: RADOMUS: You have as much time as you need.
ja: ラドマス: 時間はいくらでもかけて構わない。

key: AME: \PN?
en: AME: \PN?
ja: アメ: \PN?

key: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
en: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
ja: やあ! ジムまでたどり着いたみたいだね。

key: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
en: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
ja: この通信システムはグランドホールに直結していて、どこにいても、ジムに着いたらいつでもアドバイスをもらえるんだ!

key: Anyway...
en: Anyway...
ja: それはさておき……

key: AME: Ah, you're challenging Radomus.
en: AME: Ah, you're challenging Radomus.
ja: アメ: ああ、ラドマスに挑戦するんだね。

key: Radomus is a Doubles Leader whose strategy focuses around Trick Room.
en: Radomus is a Doubles Leader whose strategy focuses around Trick Room.
ja: ラドマスはダブルバトルのリーダーで、トリックルームを軸にした戦法を取るよ。

key: His team is bulky and hits hard, and if he sets up, then it's going to be rough going.
en: His team is bulky and hits hard, and if he sets up, then it's going to be rough going.
ja: 彼のパーティーは頑丈で火力も高くて、態勢を整えられたら、かなり手強くなる。

key: But if you can stop him from using Trick Room, then he might as well be a sitting duck.
en: But if you can stop him from using Trick Room, then he might as well be a sitting duck.
ja: でも、トリックルームを使わせないようにできれば、格好の的みたいなもんだよ。

key: Keep in mind the order your party is in can also affect battles in his arena!
en: Keep in mind the order your party is in can also affect battles in his arena!
ja: パーティーの並び順が、彼のアリーナでのバトルにも影響することを覚えておいて!

key: Your last Pokémon will always be a Queen, and your leads will always be Pawns.
en: Your last Pokémon will always be a Queen, and your leads will always be Pawns.
ja: 最後のポケモンは必ずクイーンになって、先頭のポケモンは必ずポーンになるんだ。

key: The rest depend on their stats, so plan carefully about who you want to take which role, since each one gets different effects!
en: The rest depend on their stats, so plan carefully about who you want to take which role, since each one gets different effects!
ja: 残りは能力値で決まるから、どのポケモンにどの役割を持たせたいか、慎重に計画してね、それぞれ効果が違うから!

key: Remember, Knights are the best pieces to deal with a rogue Queen!
en: Remember, Knights are the best pieces to deal with a rogue Queen!
ja: 忘れないで、暴れるクイーンに対処するには、ナイトが一番いい駒だよ!

key: Good luck!
en: Good luck!
ja: 頑張って!

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: グランドホールでは、誰も出ないようだ……

key: Skip Chess Puzzle on this file?
en: Skip Chess Puzzle on this file?
ja: このファイルのチェスパズルをスキップしますか?

key: Chess Puzzle completion has been detected from a different save file.
en: Chess Puzzle completion has been detected from a different save file.
ja: 別のセーブファイルで、チェスパズルの完了が検出されました。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
